thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 HIGH SEVERITY: gpu-hotpath-us-west1 pool reporting sustained 429s and queue growth. 5-minute 429 rate 72%. Triggered paging to #incidents and paging the on-call group.

alex: getting this alert now. 429s coming from the hotpath GPUs — autoscaler log shows failures to add replicas. seeing long queue backlog on inference-router.

priya: I'm on-call, looking. can whoever saw the spike share a quick sample of the logs?

marco: past 10min logs from router: ```
2026-03-15T12:34:21Z INFO route=hotpath pool=gpu-hotpath-us-west1 queue_depth=412
2026-03-15T12:34:22Z WARN route=hotpath pool=gpu-hotpath-us-west1 response=429 err="rate_limited" token_bucket_remaining=0
2026-03-15T12:34:30Z ERROR autoscaler controller="gpu" msg="scale up failed" reason="quota_exceeded" current_replicas=24 max_replicas=24
2026-03-15T12:34:45Z WARN pool=gpu-hotpath-us-west1 queue_depth=589
```

sasha: confirmed. autoscaler hit max_replicas. looks like the cluster quota for the region was set to 24. capacity exhausted, token bucket emptied, router started returning 429. customer-facing impact: increased error rates for hosted API in us-west1 for requests routed to large-gpu models.

priya: status check — which customers are affected? opsbot: can you give a quick summary of top clients by 429 volume?

opsbot: Top 5 tenants by 429 volume (last 10m):
- tenant-id: acme-inc (22% of 429s)
- tenant-id: quickchat (17%)
- tenant-id: docsai (12%)
- tenant-id: analytics-pro (9%)
- tenant-id: internal-sqs-tests (6%)

alex: immediate mitigation options we discussed: 1) temporarily relax per-tenant token bucket refill for gold tier 2) enable fallback routing to cpu-quantized model variant 3) bump region quota / increase max_replicas 4) degrade streaming to non-streaming for heavy requests. which to run now?

priya: run fallback routing first (fast) + relax token bucket for gold. marco, can you flip fallback routing to cpu-quantized for non-critical models? that should reduce GPU pressure by ~40% per historical traffic.

marco: doing it now. command: ```
# route all requests for model:redwood-large-v2 -> model:redwood-large-v2-cpu-fallback in us-west1
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"us-west1","match":{"pool":"gpu-hotpath","model":"redwood-large-v2"},"route_to":"redwood-large-v2-cpu-fallback","ttl_seconds":600}'
```

marco: override applied. opsbot: confirm routing change accepted.

opsbot: routing override applied (id=ovr-2026-03-15-1229). Expected GPU traffic drop ~38% for those model IDs.

sasha: i can also quickly raise token bucket refill for gold and silver tiers by 2x to keep latency-sensitive customers from getting 429s while queue drains. need an ack.

priya: do it. post the config snippet you change.

marco: token bucket config (currently): ```
{"tier":"gold","refill_per_sec":5,"capacity":100}
{"tier":"silver","refill_per_sec":2,"capacity":50}
```

marco: patching to: ```
{"tier":"gold","refill_per_sec":10,"capacity":150}
{"tier":"silver","refill_per_sec":4,"capacity":75}
```

marco: patched token bucket for gold/silver. pushing to routers now.

alex: while those mitigations run, i'm opening a request to increase regional quota with infra. we hit cloud project quota for GPUs — will need approval to bump max_replicas to 40. raising NOW. ticket: CLOUD-3421.

priya: also create an emergency canary to route 10% traffic back to hotpath to validate recovery once capacity is available. don't auto-rollback.

marco: autoscaler controller restart scheduled: ```
# restart controller on infra-control plane
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/gpu-autoscaler-controller --context=prod-us-west1
```

sasha: note — autoscaler previously logged: "scale up failed reason=quota_exceeded" so restart won't fix quota limit. need cloud quotas increased or bump to different node type.

alex: ack. i've requested quota bump and also asked infra to open emergency capacity (azure spot nodes) as a temporary measure.

incident-bot: PAGE: oncall-priya acknowledged. ETA to next update 5m.

priya: handing off to alex — i need to jump to a customer call for 10 minutes. alex, you're taking incident lead for next 20. i'll rejoin after call. @alex please summarize actions and owner list.

alex: taking lead. owner's list: marco (routing + token bucket), sasha (observability + customer impact), infra-team (quota bump + add nodes), opsbot (tenant heat map), priya (initial oncall).

marco: routing + token bucket changes are live. initial metrics look promising: queue down from 589 -> 220 in 6m, 429 rate from 72% -> 28%.

opsbot: Current numbers (post-mitigations, t+9m):
- pool queue_depth: 225
- 429 rate 30%
- avg p99 latency (hotpath): 1.4s -> 2.1s for fallback requests
- GPU utilization: 98%

alex: good. next step — infra to confirm quota bump or emergency nodes. infra: link the CLOUD-3421 ticket here when the quota is applied.

infra (via opsbot): CLOUD-3421 updated: requested increase to max_replicas=40, cloud provider approved adding 8 nodes but will take ~14 minutes to provision.

marco: once nodes land, we should scale up pool max_replicas to 40. command ready: ```
kubectl -n serving scale deploy/gpu-hotpath --replicas=40
```

opsbot: new nodes flagged ready by cloud (t+20m).

marco: scaling to 40 now.

marco: scale confirmed. pool replicas at 38 -> 40. queue draining. 429 rate falling to 3% in 3m.

sasha: customer impact summary for notes: approx 17% of production requests in us-west1 hit 429s at peak; top customers saw increased errors and higher latency; no data loss — requests are rate-limited and can be retried by clients. Escalated to CS for proactive outreach to top 5 tenants.

priya: back from call. thanks all. looks like mitigations worked. alex, can you call an incident retrospective and make a runbook change for token bucket default thresholds and regional quotas?

alex: yes — immediate action items: 1) update runbook to include a pre-approved emergency quota bump workflow (CLOUD-ops playbook) 2) add a safety limit that prevents token_bucket refill from going to zero under autoscaler failure 3) add alert to detect pooled replica saturation earlier (queue_depth threshold at 150).

marco: I'll open PR for token bucket defaults and add a migration to bump capacities.

opsbot: closing note: incident declared RESOLVED at 1855007100. final metrics appended.

sasha: filing postmortem draft. will include customer impact timeline + detection gaps + remediation steps.

alex: thanks team. adding CS and customer success to thread. follow up in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
